categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds coverage for high-risk consensus code in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp, an explicit priority area in the category definition.
categories.rationale: Adds unit test coverage for consensus validation in CheckTransaction to ensure negative outputs appearing after positive outputs are rejected. The PR description cites surviving mutant 4675 on mutanthub.space where replacing individual output value checks with cumulative output checks survived tests, closing a concrete coverage gap in consensus validation.
